continuation.description:
If the success response contains a continuation token, the list contains more items you can list. You can use this token as a query parameter and retrieve more items from the list, for example `?continuation={continuation}`.

To retrieve all items, you might need to make multiple requests.

TeamInvitation.description:
A pending invitation for an email address to join a team. The invitation record exists only
while the invitation can still be accepted.

team_id.description: The ID of the team the invitation grants access to.

email.description: The invited email address. Only an account with this email can accept.

expires_at.description:
When the invitation expires, as a Unix timestamp (in seconds). This is always 30 days
after the create or refresh request that issued it. Expired invitations can't be
accepted.

url.description:
The invitation URL. Redirect the invitee to this URL to accept the invitation. Treat it
as a secret: don't log it or send it over insecure channels. Create and a matched find
result always return this field. Unfiltered list responses omit it.

TeamMemberRole.description: The role of the member in the team.
